design_language.finish: dark satin black or very dark brown
design_language.legend_method: shallow CNC engraving with white paint fill
design_language.fallback_process: 1 mm end-mill engraving or laser engraving when the CNC shop cannot V-engrave

functions: country-specific grounded mains inlet or captive-cord module
double-pole master disconnect / breaker as specified in electrical design
rear_power_fascia.note: Compact lower utility fascia. Decorative wood is not the electrical safety enclosure; mains terminals remain inside a separate enclosed compartment.

rear_service_fascia.connector_carrier_material: 3 mm aluminum, acrylic, or equivalent replaceable thin carrier

ports.label: SERVICE DISPLAY
ports.function: HDMI diagnostic video output from PC/GPU

ports.label: RESERVE
ports.function: blank standardized position for future interface

rear_service_fascia.standardization_goal: Keep the rear utility strip low and compact; use a replaceable thin connector carrier and standardized panel-mount footprints so future ports do not require cabinet recutting.

rear_zone_rules.fasteners: four corner machine screws into threaded inserts or captive nuts; final size TBD

coin_door_service_panel.location: inside coin door, accessible from front without raising playfield

underfront_control_panel.location: underside of front edge / lockdown-bar area, hidden from standing player view
controls: three-position OFF / AUDIO / PINBALL mode selector
underfront_control_panel.engraving: white-filled legends and simple radial volume tick marks

internal_display_connections.rule: Display cables must remain accessible when the relevant service assembly is opened; do not bury connectors behind permanent structure.
